notes.title: Deep Despair 3: The Demo is now available!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3241980/
Hello everyone! I’m happy to announce that the demo version of Deep Despair 3 is now available for download! Most of the content is unavailable in this version, and you can find the list of limitations on the corresponding page. Play, leave feedback, and suggest new ideas so I can make the game even better for you!

notes.title: Shinobi Shift Live Stream!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

On October 1, the festival will begin, which will last a week, so we have prepared a demo for you, which you can play right now. [b]In the demo version, only 3 levels are available without the final boss.[/b]
Also during the festival there will be a live broadcast, where you can ask questions to the developer and leave your wishes. 

See you soon, friends!
